label: LibreChat
version: v0.8.8 (latest non-prerelease tag, 2026-10-01; main was fad2c51 on 2026-11-13, v0.8.9-rc1 prerelease exists) + @librechat/agents v4.0.1 (locked by v0.8.8) + @langchain/openai 1.5.8 (nested in agents 4.0.1). Repo moved to LibreChat-AI/LibreChat.

sources.note: Custom endpoint init: baseURL/apiKey from librechat.yaml; modelOptions = {...model_parameters, user: userId} (the LibreChat user id is sent as the OpenAI 'user' field); useLegacyContent = true; titleMethod default 'completion'.
getOpenAIConfig: streaming default true, configOptions.baseURL = configured baseURL, defaultHeaders only from yaml headers (HTTP-Referer/X-Title only for OpenRouter/Vercel gateways).

getOpenAILLMConfig: frequency/presence_penalty mapped to camelCase fields, verbosity into modelKwargs, max_tokens to maxTokens; reasoning handling lines 444-511 and 860-912 (reasoning_effort goes to modelKwargs for Chat Completions).

fetchModels: GET {baseURL}/models via axios, Authorization: Bearer <key> unless yaml headers already set Authorization, 5 s timeout, models = response.data[].id; any failure is swallowed and yields an empty list (falls back to models.default from yaml).
Optional token-config parsing of the /models response (needs pricing.prompt/completion strings and context_length); only used for OpenRouter-like endpoints, failure is harmless.
LibreChatOpenAICompletions extends LangChain's ChatOpenAICompletions; invocationParams = LangChain params + optional safety_identifier / prompt_cache_options (only when configured).
OpenAI SDK client built with maxRetries 0 and defaultHeaders passed through getHeadersWithUserAgent.

L19-L63 invocationParams: keys model, temperature, top_p, frequency_penalty, presence_penalty, logprobs, top_logprobs, n, logit_bias, stop, user, stream, tools, tool_choice, response_format, seed, stream_options ({include_usage:true} when streaming and streamUsage, which defaults to true), parallel_tool_calls, ...modelKwargs, max_tokens (max_completion_tokens for reasoning model ids), reasoning_effort; undefined keys vanish in JSON. L176-L240 stream parsing.

L570-L598 message conversion: content is the LangChain content (string stays string, arrays kept), name added when set, tool_calls from AIMessage.tool_calls, tool_call_id on tool messages; system becomes developer only for reasoning model ids. L254-L312 delta conversion (role = delta.role ?? previous role).

openAIBaseSchema/openAISchema (used for custom endpoints): user-settable keys temperature, top_p, presence_penalty, frequency_penalty, stop, max_tokens, reasoning_effort, reasoning_summary, reasoning_mode, reasoning_context, verbosity, useResponsesApi, web_search, disableStreaming; nullish values removed.

titleConvo: uses endpoint config titleConvo/titleModel/titleMethod, strips maxTokens, then run.generateTitle. The exact set of options removed by omitTitleOptions (incl. streaming) was NOT located, hence the title case is unverified.

titleMethod 'completion' (default): a single prompt 'Provide a concise, 5-word-or-less title for the conversation, using title case conventions. Only return the title itself.' + conversation, invoked on the chat model.

Docs: baseURL is the API root (app appends /chat/completions), models.fetch, titleConvo, titleModel, titleMethod, dropParams, addParams, headers, directEndpoint; the Mistral example documents that stop, user, frequency_penalty and presence_penalty are default-sent parameters.

setup.baseUrl: In librechat.yaml: endpoints.custom[].baseURL: 'http://<gateway-host>:8787/v1'  (WITH /v1: the client appends /chat/completions for chat and /models for the list; set directEndpoint: true only if you give the full /chat/completions URL)
setup.model: models.default: ['agent/sample', ...] and/or models.fetch: true to call GET /v1/models (failure silently falls back to the default list). The model picker then sends the chosen name as 'model'.
setup.apiKey: endpoints.custom[].apiKey: 'user_provided' or a literal/${ENV} key; sent as Authorization: Bearer
setup.notes: Custom endpoints exist only in librechat.yaml (no UI form). All calls are made server-side by the LibreChat Node API (OpenAI Node SDK through LangChain), no CORS. In Docker use http://host.docker.internal:8787/v1. Recommended for the gateway: titleConvo: false (or titleModel set to a cheap agent) and dropParams: ['stop','user'] if the gateway rejects those; the gateway should simply ignore unknown fields.

cases.title: Model list fetch (models.fetch: true)

evidence.note: Authorization header and URL are verified in code; Accept and User-Agent are axios defaults (inferred, not set by LibreChat).

cases.notes: Code does input.data.map(item => item.id): data must be an array of objects with id. Anything else throws inside try/catch and results in an empty list. Optional pricing/context_length are only used when the endpoint is a known FetchTokenConfig endpoint. 5 s timeout. Results are cached for 2 minutes.

cases.title: Streaming chat, default settings

evidence.note: Keys verified from LangChain invocationParams + LibreChat initialize.ts (user = LibreChat user id, streaming default true, streamUsage default true). Header set (Accept, User-Agent, X-Stainless-*) is inferred from the OpenAI Node SDK plus getHeadersWithUserAgent; the values shown are examples.

cases.notes: LibreChat user id is always sent as 'user'. temperature/top_p/frequency_penalty/presence_penalty/stop/max_tokens are present only if the user (or a preset) set them; the yaml docs, however, list stop, user, frequency_penalty, presence_penalty as 'default parameters', so a fresh preset may include frequency_penalty:0 / presence_penalty:0 / top_p / temperature (inferred, not confirmed). A system message is added only when the conversation/agent has instructions. SDK stream: unknown fields are ignored; chunks without choices[0] are skipped; a final chunk with usage and choices:[] is read for token counts. If the first delta lacks role, LangChain builds a ChatMessageChunk instead of AIMessageChunk (concat across types is likely to fail), so keep delta.role:'assistant' on the first chunk.

cases.title: Streaming chat with every optional setting the LibreChat UI/preset can set

evidence.note: Key mapping verified in LangChain invocationParams (temperature, top_p, frequency_penalty, presence_penalty, stop, max_tokens, modelKwargs spread). The UI exposing every value at once is an assumption; n, seed, logit_bias, response_format are not user-settable in this schema.

cases.notes: reasoning_effort and verbosity are written to modelKwargs and therefore appear as top-level body keys (verbosity only for non-OpenRouter). For model ids matching o1/o3/gpt-5 LibreChat drops temperature/top_p/penalties/logit_bias and uses max_completion_tokens instead of max_tokens; for ordinary agent names it keeps max_tokens. addParams from yaml are merged on top; dropParams removes keys.

cases.title: Non-streaming chat (conversation option disableStreaming)

evidence.note: disableStreaming is a user-settable conversation field in openAIBaseSchema; with streaming false LangChain emits stream:false and no stream_options (streamUsage is forced off when disableStreaming). Not observed end to end.

cases.notes: Non-stream path loops over data.choices, uses part.message.content (empty string if missing) and finish_reason; usage prompt/completion/total_tokens are read when present.

cases.title: Automatic conversation title (titleConvo, titleMethod: completion)

evidence.note: Prompt and single-user-message shape come from agents title.ts (verified). Whether the title call streams (stream:true + stream_options) depends on omitTitleOptions, which was not located. maxTokens is explicitly deleted, so no max_tokens key.

messages.content:
Provide a concise, 5-word-or-less title for the conversation, using title case conventions. Only return the title itself.

Conversation:
User: Hello
AI: Hi there

cases.notes: Body shown lists only keys believed present for certain; the real request may additionally carry stream:true and stream_options:{include_usage:true}. The gateway should answer both forms. Title uses titleModel if configured, else the same agent as the chat, i.e. an extra agent run per new conversation. Set titleConvo: false in librechat.yaml to avoid it.

cases.title: Agent/preset instructions (role system; developer only for reasoning-model ids)

evidence.note: LangChain maps system to developer only when isReasoningModel(model) (o1/o3/gpt-5 style ids); other ids keep system. That LibreChat emits a system message for promptPrefix/instructions is standard behaviour but the formatting code in api/ was not read.

cases.notes: For custom endpoints useLegacyContent is true, so text turns are plain strings, not arrays of text parts. A role 'developer' request should still be accepted by the gateway in case an agent is named like a reasoning model.

cases.title: User message with an attached image (resendFiles)

evidence.note: Array content is forwarded as-is by the converter; LibreChat's image encoding (image_url with data: URL and detail from imageDetail, default auto) is assumed from its schema (imageDetail default 'auto'), not read in api/ code.

cases.notes: LangChain turns a 400 whose message mentions tool_calls into INVALID_TOOL_RESULTS and 404 into MODEL_NOT_FOUND; other 400s are shown to the user as the raw error message. Use the standard OpenAI error body.

cases.title: Follow-up turn after a tool call by an agent with tools

evidence.note: Converter output verified: {role, content} (+name when set) with tool_calls from AIMessage.tool_calls, and tool messages with tool_call_id. Whether content is '' or null or [] for a call-only assistant turn depends on how LibreChat builds the AIMessage (not read); '' is the most likely.

messages.content: What is the weather in Paris?

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Get the weather for a city

cases.notes: The gateway should tolerate content as '', null or an empty array on assistant tool-call messages, and an extra name field on tool messages. tool arguments are JSON strings.

cases.title: Request of an agent with tools attached (tools only; tool_choice/parallel_tool_calls not set by default)

evidence.note: tools, tool_choice and parallel_tool_calls are only emitted when LangGraph's bindTools passes them as call options; by default tool_choice and parallel_tool_calls are undefined (dropped from JSON). Tool schema may include strict:true when the agent SDK enables strict tools (stripIntentFromStrictTools exists).

evidence.note: For Chat Completions the effort ends up as modelKwargs.reasoning_effort (top-level body key). With useResponsesApi (not default for custom endpoints) it would go to the Responses API instead.
